summary: AstraZeneca PLC furnished a Form 6-K containing an exhibit titled 'Total Voting Rights,' a routine UK Financial Conduct Authority Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1 notification. As at 30 September 2026, issued share capital with voting rights was 1,551,053,289 ordinary shares of US$0.25, with no shares held in Treasury; total voting rights were therefore 1,551,053,289. Filed 1 October 2026 and signed by Company Secretary Matthew Bowden. The figure serves as shareholders' denominator for UK DTR interest notifications. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, pricing term, or risk-arb angle is present; purely an administrative disclosure.
